1001.en: Most students are willing to help with the open day.
1001.zh: 大多数学生愿意为开放日帮忙。

1002.en: The new interns are eager to learn everything quickly.
1002.zh: 新实习生们渴望尽快学会所有东西。

1003.en: She is very keen on photography and wildlife.
1003.zh: 她非常热衷于摄影和野生动物。

1004.en: Anyone interested in joining the choir should email the organizer.
1004.zh: 有兴趣加入合唱团的人请给组织者发邮件。

1005.en: Children are naturally curious about how things work.
1005.zh: 孩子们天生对事物的运作原理充满好奇。

1006.en: An inquisitive mind is a great asset for a researcher.
1006.zh: 好奇好问的头脑是研究者的宝贵财富。

1007.en: She gave the speaker an inquiring look.
1007.zh: 她用探询的目光看着演讲者。

1008.en: A questioning attitude is encouraged in science classes.
1008.zh: 科学课上鼓励质疑的态度。

1009.en: The committee was doubtful about the cost of the plan.
1009.zh: 委员会对该计划的成本表示怀疑。

1010.en: The future of the old theatre is still uncertain.
1010.zh: 老剧院的未来仍不确定。

1011.en: If you are unsure about the answer, ask your tutor.
1011.zh: 如果你对答案没把握，就去问导师。

1012.en: Many students were confused by the new timetable.
1012.zh: 许多学生被新的时间表弄糊涂了。

1013.en: She looked puzzled when she saw the exam question.
1013.zh: 看到考题时她一脸迷惑。

1014.en: The scientists were perplexed by the strange results.
1014.zh: 科学家们对这些奇怪的结果感到困惑不解。

1015.en: New arrivals often feel bewildered at the huge airport.
1015.zh: 初来乍到的人在这座巨大的机场常常不知所措。

1016.en: Doctors were baffled by the patient's unusual symptoms.
1016.zh: 医生们对病人不寻常的症状百思不解。

1017.en: The audience was mystified by the magician's final trick.
1017.zh: 观众对魔术师的最后一个戏法大惑不解。

1018.en: The mysterious lights in the sky turned out to be satellites.
1018.zh: 天空中的神秘亮光原来是卫星。

1019.en: It feels strange to hear your own recorded voice.
1019.zh: 听到自己录音的声音感觉很奇怪。

1020.en: It seems odd that the office is closed on a weekday.
1020.zh: 办公室在工作日关门，这似乎很奇怪。

1021.en: The fruit has a peculiar smell but tastes sweet.
1021.zh: 这种水果有股奇特的气味，但吃起来很甜。

1022.en: It is unusual to see snow in this region.
1022.zh: 在这个地区见到雪是很不寻常的。

1023.en: The library holds an extraordinary collection of old maps.
1023.zh: 图书馆收藏着一批非凡的古地图。

1024.en: The team made remarkable progress in just one term.
1024.zh: 这个团队在一个学期内取得了显著进步。

1025.en: She received an award for outstanding academic achievement.
1025.zh: 她因杰出的学业成绩获奖。

1026.en: The hotel has an excellent view of the harbour.
1026.zh: 这家酒店可以看到极好的海港景色。

1027.en: The orchestra gave a superb performance last night.
1027.zh: 乐团昨晚的演出精彩绝伦。

1028.en: The cathedral has a magnificent stained-glass window.
1028.zh: 大教堂有一扇壮丽的彩色玻璃窗。

1029.en: We had a splendid view of the mountains from the train.
1029.zh: 从火车上我们看到了壮观的山景。

1030.en: Thank you for a wonderful evening at the concert.
1030.zh: 谢谢你让我度过了一个精彩的音乐会之夜。

1031.en: The doctors did a marvelous job saving the patient.
1031.zh: 医生们出色地救治了病人。

1032.en: It is amazing how quickly children pick up languages.
1032.zh: 孩子们学语言的速度之快令人惊奇。

1033.en: The study revealed an astonishing fact about sleep.
1033.zh: 这项研究揭示了一个关于睡眠的惊人事实。

1034.en: It is surprising that so few students use the gym.
1034.zh: 用健身房的学生这么少，真令人惊讶。

1035.en: The report contains shocking figures about food waste.
1035.zh: 这份报告包含关于食物浪费的惊人数字。

1036.en: The survey produced some startling results.
1036.zh: 这项调查得出了一些令人吃惊的结果。

1037.en: The rainforest is disappearing at an alarming rate.
1037.zh: 雨林正以令人担忧的速度消失。

1038.en: The first driving lesson can be a frightening experience.
1038.zh: 第一次驾驶课可能是一次吓人的经历。

1039.en: Being caught in the storm at sea was terrifying.
1039.zh: 在海上遭遇风暴非常恐怖。

1040.en: The traffic was horrible during the festival.
1040.zh: 节日期间交通糟糕透了。

1041.en: The weather was terrible for the whole trip.
1041.zh: 整个旅途天气都很糟糕。

1042.en: The food at the conference was awful.

1043.en: We had dreadful weather on the day of the boat trip.
1043.zh: 乘船出游那天天气糟糕透顶。

1044.en: Eating late at night is a bad habit.

1045.en: His poor eyesight makes reading small print difficult.
1045.zh: 他视力不好，读小字很吃力。

1046.en: The copies are of inferior quality compared with the originals.
1046.zh: 与原件相比，复印件质量较差。

1047.en: The film received mediocre reviews from critics.
1047.zh: 这部电影得到的影评平平。

1048.en: The average student spends four hours a day studying.
1048.zh: 学生平均每天学习四个小时。

1049.en: It was just an ordinary Monday morning on campus.
1049.zh: 那只是校园里一个普通的周一早晨。

1050.en: It is normal for new students to feel homesick.

1051.en: Regular attendance is expected at all seminars.
1051.zh: 所有研讨课都要求按时出席。

1052.en: A standard room costs eighty pounds a night.

1053.en: This painting is typical of her early style.
1053.zh: 这幅画是她早期风格的典型代表。

1054.en: Conventional farming uses more water than the new method.
1054.zh: 传统耕作方式比新方法用水更多。

1055.en: The dancers wore traditional costumes at the festival.
1055.zh: 舞者们在节日上穿着传统服装。

1056.en: She prefers classical music when she is studying.
1056.zh: 学习时她更喜欢听古典音乐。

1057.en: The city walls date back to ancient times.
1057.zh: 这座城墙可以追溯到古代。

1058.en: The old lecture theatre is being renovated this summer.
1058.zh: 旧的阶梯教室今年夏天正在翻修。

1059.en: The charity delivers meals to aged residents.
1059.zh: 慈善机构为年老的居民送餐。

1060.en: The elderly couple next door often invite students for tea.
1060.zh: 隔壁的老夫妇经常请学生们喝茶。

1061.en: Mature students often bring work experience to the class.
1061.zh: 成年学生往往能把工作经验带进课堂。

1062.en: An adult elephant eats about 150 kilograms of food a day.
1062.zh: 一头成年大象每天大约吃150公斤食物。

1063.en: Their grown children now live in different cities.
1063.zh: 他们已长大成人的孩子如今住在不同的城市。

1064.en: Recycling rates are higher in developed countries.
1064.zh: 发达国家的回收率更高。

1065.en: She joined an advanced writing class this term.
1065.zh: 这学期她加入了高级写作班。

1066.en: The museum combines modern design with old exhibits.
1066.zh: 博物馆将现代设计与古老展品相结合。

1067.en: The gallery shows work by contemporary artists.
1067.zh: 这家画廊展出当代艺术家的作品。

1068.en: Her current project studies bird migration routes.
1068.zh: 她当前的项目研究鸟类迁徙路线。

1069.en: All members were present at the annual meeting.
1069.zh: 全体成员都出席了年会。

1070.en: Recent research has changed our view of dolphin intelligence.
1070.zh: 最近的研究改变了我们对海豚智力的看法。

1071.en: The latest edition of the textbook includes online exercises.
1071.zh: 教材的最新版包含在线练习。

1072.en: The new sports centre opens next month.
1072.zh: 新体育中心下个月开放。

1073.en: The market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
1073.zh: 市场每天早上出售新鲜蔬菜。

1074.en: The engineers came up with a novel solution to the problem.
1074.zh: 工程师们想出了一个新颖的解决方案。

1075.en: Your essay must be entirely original work.
1075.zh: 你的论文必须完全是原创作品。

1076.en: Each snowflake has a unique pattern.
1076.zh: 每片雪花都有独特的图案。

1077.en: The building's distinctive roof makes it easy to find.
1077.zh: 这座建筑独特的屋顶让它很容易辨认。

1078.en: The chef prepared a special menu for the ceremony.
1078.zh: 主厨为典礼准备了特别菜单。

1079.en: Is there a particular topic you want to discuss?
1079.zh: 你有特别想讨论的话题吗？

1080.en: Each student receives individual feedback on their essays.
1080.zh: 每个学生的论文都会得到一对一的反馈。

1081.en: A single room in the hall costs more than a shared one.
1081.zh: 宿舍单人间比合住间贵。

1082.en: The sole purpose of the trip is to collect samples.
1082.zh: 这次出行的唯一目的是采集样本。

1083.en: This is the only bus that goes to the airport.
1083.zh: 这是唯一一班开往机场的公交车。

1084.en: She travelled alone across South America for a year.
1084.zh: 她独自一人在南美旅行了一年。

1085.en: Students far from home sometimes feel lonely.
1085.zh: 远离家乡的学生有时会感到孤独。

1086.en: The research station is isolated for months in winter.
1086.zh: 研究站在冬天有好几个月与外界隔绝。

1087.en: Doctors fly to remote villages once a month.
1087.zh: 医生每月飞往偏远村庄一次。

1088.en: You can see the distant mountains from the top floor.
1088.zh: 从顶楼可以望见远处的群山。

1089.en: The station is not far from the university.

1090.en: Is there a cash machine near here?

1091.en: The two lab results are very close to each other.
1091.zh: 两次实验结果非常接近。

1092.en: The car park is adjacent to the sports hall.

1093.en: Noise from neighboring rooms can disturb your study.
1093.zh: 邻近房间的噪音会干扰你学习。

1094.en: There is a nearby park where students go jogging.
1094.zh: 附近有个公园，学生们常去慢跑。

1095.en: The hotel offers tours of the surrounding countryside.
1095.zh: 酒店提供周边乡村的游览项目。

1096.en: Cutting plastic use is good for the environment.
1096.zh: 减少塑料使用对环境有益。

1097.en: The story takes place in a rural setting.
1097.zh: 故事发生在乡村背景下。

1098.en: You can often guess a word's meaning from its context.
1098.zh: 你常常可以根据上下文猜出单词的意思。

1099.en: Students from different backgrounds share the same dormitory.
1099.zh: 来自不同背景的学生住在同一间宿舍。

1100.en: The professor specialises in the history of medicine.
1100.zh: 这位教授专门研究医学史。
